neighbours.label: 'meet' / 'met' in its abstract sense: to encounter an outcome or satisfy a standard (met with success, meet the requirements, met their match)
fire: Earlier attempts to cure the disease have met with little success.
The new building does not meet the fire safety standards.
The champion finally met his match in the young challenger.
Most applicants easily meet the minimum requirements.
The proposal met strong resistance from local residents.
The old star will meet a violent end as a supernova.
The factory struggled to meet growing demand last winter.
Their plan met with approval from the whole committee.
quiet: Earlier attempts to cure the disease have been funded by charities.
The new building does not have enough parking for staff.
The champion finally lost to the young challenger.
Most applicants easily pass the written exam.
The proposal faced strong resistance from local residents.
The old star will end its life as a supernova.
The factory struggled to produce enough cars last winter.
Their plan won approval from the whole committee.
